bookingOpens: Online through Guestonline from the restaurant's website, or by phone. Parties of more than five should phone or email contact@tourdargent.com.
groups: Parties of more than five book by phone or by email to contact@tourdargent.com.
dressCode: A jacket is required for men at lunch and dinner, and elegant dress is expected for everyone. No sportswear, shorts or T-shirts.
children: Children aged 6 and over are preferred.
photoAlt: The entrance of La Tour d'Argent with its name above the door, Paris

stay.name: L’Appartement de la Tour d’Argent
stay.note: A private apartment on the fifth floor of the building facing Notre-Dame, booked by request through guest relations; dinner is not part of the rate.
